headline: I Got Blown Up in Iraq. Years Later, Amputating My Leg Set Me Free.
snippet: Injuries from the war in Iraq left me barely able to walk without further hurting myself. It took a drastic decision to reclaim my life.

headline: In the Final, Youth Serves
snippet: It was a half-hour after match point, near the front row inside Arthur Ashe Stadium, when a group of smitten fans and nudging camera operators were circling Marat Safin as if they were surrounding a campfire.

headline: Travel Advisory: Ski Resorts Pledge to Protect Natural Areas
snippet: At the nation's biggest ski resorts, trail maps this season will be emblazoned with a proclamation of environmental good will. "Sustainable Slopes," the new program, is the product of a ski industry association campaign to quiet critics and to reassure visitors that its members are committed to protecting natural areas.
